selection.reason: Tie on every criterion: DELIVERY and CONFORMANCE both hold — exactly keys `count`, `sum`, `mean`, numeric, no extras; the JSON is well-formed with no placeholders. INTERNAL CONSISTENCY holds (12.0/3 = 4.0). FIDELITY is only partly checkable, since the source section gives the CSV's metadata but not its values, so the 12.0 sum is unverified by the evidence; the 25-byte size is consistent with three single-digit values. The files are byte-identical, so no defect separates them. A is chosen arbitrarily as the earlier of the two; B is the runner-up and costs nothing beyond being the identical duplicate.
